gaps.note: Missing bars are compared with the NYSE calendar; no bar is invented.

rules: Numbers without a time zone offset are read as epoch time: seconds, milliseconds or microseconds, chosen by size.
Text timestamps without an offset are read in the time zone you declare; without a declared time zone the import stops and asks for one.

A repeated local hour when clocks go back is resolved from the order of the rows (first pass daylight time, second pass standard time); if the order does not tell, the first occurrence is used and a warning says so.
A local time that does not exist because clocks moved forward is an error.
A file sorted newest first is reversed, with a warning; any other disorder is an error.
